reviewDepthApplicability.reason: non-trivial target: a 157-file packet with runtime code, guards and a CI workflow

targetSelection.selectionReason: the dimension names these surfaces; enforcement producers were read end to end with their consumers

searchLedger.hypothesis: fetched page text leaves the machine and attacker text reaches the system prompt

searchActions.result: screen runs only behind the injection-screen feature gate, pipes section text to the operator Jev classifier, and returns an advisory carrying counts and positions only

searchLedger.rationale: operator-gated, same trust domain as the repo other Jev uses, and the advisory payload cannot carry page text into the system prompt
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of the adapter and its delegates

searchLedger.hypothesis: model-authored packetPath reads or writes outside the workspace

searchActions.result: resolvePacketDir refuses lexically escaping paths and re-checks real paths including symlinked parents; bindGoal fails closed with PACKET_GOAL_NOT_FOUND

searchLedger.rationale: containment is enforced on real paths and the in-scope call site fails closed; the packet path is read-only, never a write target
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of the delegate containment code

searchLedger.hypothesis: the OPENCODE_BIN probe executes an attacker-named binary

searchActions.result: probe target comes from operator env only, path-separated and empty values return unknown, and the probe is bounded at three seconds with a single --version argument

searchLedger.rationale: no command-string path reaches the probe target; the adversarial tests pin the argument shape
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read plus the module adversarial tests

searchLedger.hypothesis: plugin subprocess calls can be steered by environment or model input

searchActions.result: script paths are fixed under REPO_ROOT, spawns are exec-form with no shell string, eight-second timeout, PID env vars cleared before cleanup, orphan sweep opt-in

searchLedger.rationale: no interpolated command string and no model-controlled argument reaches a spawn
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of every call site

searchLedger.hypothesis: a model-supplied workdir points the gate at a different rulebook

searchActions.result: readGit follows -C so the checked contract follows the commit target, -R is refused, and unreadable bodies fall through to the git hooks and CI

searchLedger.rationale: the checked directory follows the commit directory and the documented fail-open is backed by commit-msg, pre-push and CI
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of both adapter and delegate

searchLedger.hypothesis: the negative-control marker is reachable outside test scenarios

searchActions.result: the marker is a regex over the evaluated command text and passes two checks

searchLedger.hypothesis: the audit kill switch also disables the blocking guard

searchActions.result: the before-hook returns before enforcement when the audit env switch is set

searchLedger.hypothesis: unmodeled wrappers and prefixes skip classification entirely

searchActions.result: subshell parens, bang, nohup/command and env -S are not in the modeled wrapper set and classify none for print-flagless shapes

searchLedger.hypothesis: the unknown-version downgrade weakens blocking rules

searchActions.result: single-family error rules downgrade to warn when the family is unknown; the catalog documents this

searchLedger.rationale: already tracked as active correctness finding R1-P2-002; not re-filed
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: duplicate of an existing active finding

searchLedger.hypothesis: the workflow interpolates untrusted event input into run blocks

searchActions.result: contents read only, SHA-pinned actions, no pull_request_target, run blocks interpolate matrix constants and runner temp only

searchLedger.rationale: no attacker-controlled event field reaches a run block
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read; file is outside the manifest but named by this dimension

searchLedger.hypothesis: the audit line records secrets from the command or output

searchActions.result: scrubbing covers flag, assignment, header and colon forms plus bare provider tokens, PEM blocks and JWTs; the command is bounded at 500 chars; outputText is never serialized

searchLedger.rationale: the recorded surface is bounded and scrubbed; only outputBytes is recorded, never output text
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: verified by direct read of the patterns and the line builder

searchLedger.hypothesis: the setup helper can clobber files or leave probe state behind

searchActions.result: launcher write refuses symlinks and byte-compares before replacing, probe dir is mktemp with an EXIT trap, npm versions pinned, all paths derive from HOME

searchLedger.rationale: writes are idempotent, refusal-first on symlinks, and the temp probe dir is cleaned by trap
